responsibility: Defines rustc’s shared middle-layer trait-system model and interfaces: the root module provides the core compiler-facing trait-resolution data types and obligation/reporting concepts, `query.rs` defines the canonical query payloads and results used by trait/type-operation providers, `select.rs` supplies the classic solver’s shared selection caches, candidate sets, and evaluation outcomes, `specialization_graph.rs` represents trait specialization relationships and specialized item lookup, `chalk.rs` bridges these trait concepts to Chalk’s IR and query inputs, `util.rs` offers lightweight supertrait/implied-clause elaboration for diagnostics and printing, and `structural_impls.rs` provides the manual debug formatting needed for key trait-resolution structures.
